#1 — The rise of shadow AI is exposing the gaps in enterprise data governance — YourStory

★ Directly addresses governance challenges as employees adopt AI tools outside approved systems—a core concern for enterprise AI implementation strategy under Cristiano's Content Operating System framework.

IDC estimates more than half of employees are already using AI tools outside approved corporate environments. Generative AI is exposing how organizations struggle with data governance as autonomous tool adoption accelerates faster than policy frameworks can absorb.
